Eclampsia, life-threatening to mother and fetus

red_flags_en.finding: Severe hypertension or decreased fetal movement
red_flags_en.rationale: Requires immediate assessment of maternal-fetal safety

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 出現嚴重徵象時不適用常規針灸照護
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 懷孕本身即須謹慎選穴與手法；嚴重子癲前症／子癲症須由產科團隊主導處置
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的產科醫師聯絡協調照護，絕不可延誤緊急產科評估
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch K Reproductive/Gyne/Urology（依據 NICHD 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 此為妊娠急症光譜，針灸角色須嚴格限縮於產科團隊協調之下

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not a condition for routine acupuncture management when severe features are present
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Pregnancy itself requires cautious point selection and technique; severe preeclampsia/eclampsia must be led by the obstetric team
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Coordinate with the patient's obstetric team; never delay emergency obstetric evaluation
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch K Reproductive/Gyne/Urology (compiled from NICHD clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: This spans a pregnancy-emergency spectrum; acupuncture's role must be strictly subordinate to obstetric team coordination

records.summary_zh: 急性閉角型青光眼是房水外流突然受阻，造成眼內壓急遽升高並威脅視力的眼科急症。
records.summary_en: Acute angle-closure glaucoma is sudden obstruction of aqueous outflow causing a rapid rise in intraocular pressure and threat to vision.
records.etiology_zh: 解剖上房角較窄者易感；瞳孔散大或其他誘發因子可促發房角關閉。
records.etiology_en: Anatomically narrow angles predispose; pupillary dilation or other triggers can precipitate closure.
records.western_pathology_zh: 虹膜阻塞小樑網引流，使眼內壓急速上升並損傷視神經與眼部結構。
records.western_pathology_en: Iris blocks trabecular drainage, rapidly increasing intraocular pressure and injuring optic nerve/ocular structures.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：屬於眼科急症，與慢性隅角開放性青光眼為不同狀態。

臨床表現：劇烈眼痛、紅眼、視力模糊／光暈、頭痛、噁心嘔吐。

重要特徵：眼科急症、眼內壓急速上升、疼痛性紅眼、視力可能快速喪失。

診斷方法：緊急眼科檢查，測量眼內壓並評估房角與視神經。

鑑別診斷：葡萄膜炎、角膜炎、偏頭痛、結膜炎、眼眶蜂窩性組織炎。

西醫治療：快速降眼壓藥物，隨後接受雷射虹膜切開術等眼科處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: It is a medical emergency and distinct from chronic open-angle glaucoma.

Clinical presentation: Severe eye pain, red eye, blurred vision/halos, headache, nausea/vomiting.

Key features: ocular emergency, rapid IOP rise, painful red eye, vision loss can occur quickly.

Diagnostic approach: Urgent eye exam with intraocular pressure and angle/optic evaluation.

Differential diagnosis: uveitis, keratitis, migraine, conjunctivitis, orbital cellulitis.

Western treatment: Rapid pressure-lowering medication followed by laser iridotomy and other ophthalmic treatment.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_zh.finding: 劇烈眼痛合併紅眼、噁心與視力模糊
red_flags_zh.rationale: 為眼科急症，延誤可能造成永久性視力喪失

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden intense eye pain with red eye, nausea and blurred vision
red_flags_en.rationale: Ocular emergency; delay can cause permanent vision loss

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不適用——不得於眼周針刺或延誤轉診
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 任何疑似急性閉角型青光眼徵象須立即轉診，不進行眼周治療
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 立即轉診眼科／急診
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies（依據 NEI 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 此為眼科急症，針灸角色僅限於緊急轉診之後的恢復期輔助照護

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not applicable — do not needle around the eye or delay referral when acute angle closure is possible
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Any suspected acute angle-closure glaucoma requires immediate referral, not periocular treatment
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Immediate referral to ophthalmology/emergency care
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies (compiled from NEI clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: This is an ocular emergency; acupuncture's role is limited to recovery-phase support after emergency referral

records.summary_zh: 視網膜剝離是視網膜自其正常位置分離的視力威脅急症。
records.summary_en: Retinal detachment occurs when the retina separates from its normal position and is a vision-threatening emergency.
records.etiology_zh: 視網膜裂孔、糖尿病牽引、發炎／滲出性疾病、外傷及既往眼科手術皆可能造成不同類型的視網膜剝離。
records.etiology_en: Retinal tears, diabetic traction, inflammatory/exudative disease, trauma and prior eye surgery can cause different types.
records.western_pathology_zh: 神經感覺層視網膜自下方支持組織分離，干擾光受器功能並可能造成永久性視力喪失。
records.western_pathology_en: Separation of neurosensory retina from underlying support disrupts photoreceptor function and can cause permanent vision loss.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：主要類型包括裂孔性、牽引性與滲出性；玻璃體後脫離為風險因子／鑑別診斷，非相同疾病。

臨床表現：突發新發飛蚊症、閃光感與視野出現陰影／簾幕感；黃斑部剝離時中心視力可能下降。

重要特徵：醫療急症、飛蚊症＋閃光＋簾幕感為高指標性表現、須散瞳檢查、早期手術／雷射可保護視力。

診斷方法：散瞳眼底檢查；必要時輔以眼部超音波或 OCT。

鑑別診斷：玻璃體後脫離、眼性偏頭痛、玻璃體出血、視網膜血管阻塞。

西醫治療：依類型選擇雷射／冷凍治療裂孔，或氣體視網膜固定術、鞏膜扣壓術、玻璃體切除術等處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Major types are rhegmatogenous, tractional and exudative; posterior vitreous detachment is a risk/differential but not the same condition.

Clinical presentation: Sudden new floaters, flashes of light and a shadow/curtain over vision; central acuity may decline as macula detaches.

Key features: medical emergency, floaters + flashes + curtain high-yield, dilated exam, early surgery/laser protects vision.

Diagnostic approach: Dilated retinal exam; ocular ultrasound/OCT when needed.

Differential diagnosis: posterior vitreous detachment, ocular migraine, vitreous hemorrhage, retinal vascular occlusion.

Western treatment: Laser/cryo for tears and procedures such as pneumatic retinopexy, scleral buckle or vitrectomy for detachment depending type.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 既往眼科手術或外傷史

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發性飛蚊症、閃光或視野簾幕感
red_flags_zh.rationale: 延誤處置可能造成永久性視力喪失

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden floaters, flashes or visual curtain/shadow
red_flags_en.rationale: Delayed treatment can cause permanent vision loss

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不適用——急性症狀須交由眼科處理
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 在排除急症病因之前避免眼周治療
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 立即轉診眼科
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies（依據 NEI 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 此為眼科急症，針灸角色僅限於緊急轉診之後的恢復期輔助照護

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not applicable — acute symptoms require ophthalmology, not acupuncture
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Avoid ocular-area treatment until emergency causes excluded
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Immediate referral to ophthalmology
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies (compiled from NEI clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: This is an ocular emergency; acupuncture's role is limited to recovery-phase support after emergency referral

records.name_zh: 突發性感音神經性聽力損失
records.summary_zh: 突發性感音神經性聽力損失是數小時至數天內快速出現、原因不明之內耳聽力損失，多為單側，屬於醫療急症。
records.summary_en: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSHL) is rapid unexplained inner-ear hearing loss developing over hours to a few days, often unilateral, and is a medical emergency.
records.etiology_zh: 多數為特發性；感染、自體免疫疾病、循環問題、神經疾病、外傷或耳毒性藥物皆可能為病因。
records.etiology_en: Most cases are idiopathic; infections, autoimmune disease, circulation problems, neurologic disease, trauma or ototoxic drugs can be causes.
records.western_pathology_zh: 耳蝸／內耳感覺路徑急性功能障礙，造成快速的感音神經性閾值損失。
records.western_pathology_en: Acute dysfunction of cochlear/inner-ear sensory pathways produces rapid sensorineural threshold loss.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：屬於時間敏感的醫療急症，須立即與耳垢／積液造成的傳導性聽力損失及慢性聽力損失區分；與慢性耳鳴／感音神經性聽損（見 cond.hearing_loss）為不同臨床狀態，不應以慢性耳鳴常規處置延誤評估。

臨床表現：常於睡醒時發現的單側突發聽力損失，可合併耳鳴、耳脹感及／或暈眩。

重要特徵：時間敏感急症、多為單側、應於數天內完成聽力檢測、常考慮類固醇治療。

診斷方法：先排除傳導性聽力損失，並進行純音聽力檢測；視情況加做影像／血液檢查尋找病因。

鑑別診斷：耳垢阻塞、中耳炎、梅尼爾氏症、聽神經瘤、腦中風。

西醫治療：適當個案常使用類固醇治療；找到病因時依病因處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: It must be distinguished promptly from conductive loss due to cerumen/fluid and from chronic hearing loss; this is a distinct clinical state from the chronic tinnitus/sensorineural hearing loss picture in cond.hearing_loss and should not be managed with routine chronic-tinnitus care that delays evaluation.

Clinical presentation: Sudden unilateral hearing loss, sometimes noticed on waking, with tinnitus, ear fullness and/or dizziness.

Key features: time-sensitive emergency, often unilateral, audiometry within days, steroids commonly considered.

Diagnostic approach: Rule out conductive loss and obtain pure-tone audiometry; additional imaging/labs seek underlying cause.

Differential diagnosis: cerumen impaction, otitis media, Ménière disease, vestibular schwannoma, stroke.

Western treatment: Corticosteroid treatment is commonly used when appropriate; cause-specific management if identified.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即醫療／耳鼻喉科評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 屬於時間敏感急症，及早評估與治療影響預後
提示中樞／血管性病因

red_flags_en.rationale: Time-sensitive emergency; early evaluation and treatment affect outcome
Raises central/vascular concern

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不適用於初期處置——不得以慢性耳鳴耳聾常規照護取代急症評估
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不得將突發性聽力損失標記為慢性耳鳴耳聾而延誤轉診
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 立即轉診耳鼻喉科／急診
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies（依據 NIDCD 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 此為時間敏感急症，針灸角色僅限於緊急轉診之後的恢復期輔助照護

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Not applicable for initial management — do not label sudden hearing loss as chronic tinnitus/hearing loss and begin routine care first
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Time-to-evaluation matters; do not delay referral
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Immediate referral to ENT/emergency care
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies (compiled from NIDCD clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: This is a time-sensitive emergency; acupuncture's role is limited to recovery-phase support after emergency referral

records.summary_zh: 急性細菌性鼻竇炎是通常繼發於病毒性上呼吸道感染之副鼻竇細菌性感染／發炎，須與病毒性鼻竇炎區分。
records.summary_en: Acute bacterial rhinosinusitis is bacterial infection/inflammation of the paranasal sinuses, usually following a viral URI, and must be distinguished from viral rhinosinusitis.
records.etiology_zh: 常見細菌病原體於病毒性上呼吸道感染後或其他易感因子下，感染阻塞發炎的鼻竇。
records.etiology_en: Common bacterial pathogens infect obstructed/inflamed sinuses after viral URI or other predisposition.
records.western_pathology_zh: 黏膜水腫阻塞引流，使細菌得以感染並造成壓力與發炎。
records.western_pathology_en: Mucosal edema obstructs drainage, allowing bacterial infection and pressure/inflammation.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：與慢性鼻竇炎為不同的臨床狀態（此為急性、通常繼發於病毒感染），也與單純病毒性鼻竇炎不同；單純膿性分泌物不足以證實細菌感染，須依病程與惡化型態判斷。

臨床表現：鼻塞／鼻分泌物、顏面疼痛／壓迫感、嗅覺減退，可能合併發燒。

重要特徵：病毒與細菌鑑別重要、持續／嚴重／雙重惡化型態具意義、眼眶／顱內併發症少見但嚴重、抗生素使用須有選擇性。

診斷方法：多以臨床診斷為主；影像保留於併發症或替代診斷之評估。

鑑別診斷：病毒性上呼吸道感染、過敏性鼻炎、牙源性感染、偏頭痛、慢性鼻竇炎。

西醫治療：症狀治療，並依細菌感染條件／嚴重度選擇性使用抗生素；併發症須緊急處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Distinct from chronic sinusitis (this is acute, usually secondary to viral infection) and from simple viral rhinosinusitis; purulent discharge alone does not prove bacterial infection — duration/severity/worsening pattern guides diagnosis.

Clinical presentation: Nasal obstruction/discharge, facial pain/pressure, reduced smell and sometimes fever.

Key features: viral vs bacterial distinction, persistent/severe/double-worsening patterns matter, orbital/intracranial complications rare but serious, antibiotics selective.

Diagnostic approach: Usually clinical; imaging reserved for complications/alternative diagnosis.

Differential diagnosis: viral URI, allergic rhinitis, dental infection, migraine, chronic rhinosinusitis.

Western treatment: Symptomatic care and antibiotics when bacterial criteria/severity indicate; treat complications urgently.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 近期病毒性上呼吸道感染

red_flags_zh.finding: 眼眶周圍腫脹或視力改變
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示眼眶／顱內併發症

red_flags_zh.finding: 嚴重頭痛合併神經學徵象
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示顱內併發症

red_flags_zh.finding: 高度全身性中毒症狀或免疫低下
red_flags_zh.rationale: 併發症風險較高

red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests orbital/intracranial complication
Suggests intracranial complication
Elevated complication risk

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 在排除眼眶／顱內危險徵象後，可作為症狀輔助照護
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 眼眶周圍腫脹、視力改變或嚴重頭痛須先排除併發症
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 若使用抗生素治療，與病人的處方醫師聯絡確認治療進度
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies（依據 MedlinePlus 臨床資料整理）
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 尚未查到專屬於急性細菌性鼻竇炎的針灸療效臨床指引，此為執業範圍謹慎建議

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Adjunctive symptom care only after dangerous orbital/intracranial features excluded
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Periorbital swelling, vision change or severe headache require complication evaluation first
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: If antibiotics are prescribed, contact the prescriber to confirm treatment progress
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AcuTing OS Disease Knowledge Research Pack — Batch L ENT/Ophthalmic Emergencies (compiled from MedlinePlus clinical materials)
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for acute bacterial rhinosinusitis was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 中耳炎是中耳的發炎／感染；急性中耳炎與中耳積水為不同狀態。
records.summary_en: Otitis media is inflammation/infection of the middle ear; acute otitis media and otitis media with effusion are distinct.
records.etiology_zh: 病毒性上呼吸道感染後常出現耳咽管功能障礙，使中耳積液並可能合併細菌／病毒感染，兒童尤其常見。
records.etiology_en: Eustachian-tube dysfunction after viral URI can permit middle-ear fluid and bacterial/viral infection, especially in children.
records.western_pathology_zh: 中耳壓力與積液合併發炎，造成耳痛與傳導性聽力改變。
records.western_pathology_en: Middle-ear pressure/fluid and inflammation cause pain and conductive hearing changes.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：中耳疾病與外耳炎及突發性感音神經性聽力損失為不同狀態。

臨床表現：耳痛、發燒、易怒、聽力減退及鼓膜變化；積水可在無急性感染下持續存在。

重要特徵：急性中耳炎與積水須區分、耳鏡檢查為核心、聽力變化多為傳導性、乳突炎併發症少見但嚴重。

診斷方法：耳鏡檢查確認中耳積液／發炎；持續積水或聽力損失須加做聽力檢測。

鑑別診斷：外耳炎、耳垢阻塞、顳顎關節／牙源性疼痛、突發性感音神經性聽力損失、乳突炎。

西醫治療：依年齡、嚴重度與診斷確定性選擇止痛與觀察或抗生素治療；反覆／持續積水個案可考慮中耳通氣管置入。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Middle-ear disease is distinct from otitis externa and sudden sensorineural hearing loss.

Clinical presentation: Ear pain, fever, irritability, reduced hearing and tympanic-membrane changes; effusion can persist without acute infection.

Key features: AOM vs effusion, otoscopy central, hearing changes usually conductive, mastoid complications uncommon but serious.

Diagnostic approach: Otoscopy showing middle-ear effusion/inflammation; hearing testing for persistent effusion/loss.

Differential diagnosis: otitis externa, cerumen, TMJ/dental pain, SSHL, mastoiditis.

Western treatment: Analgesia and observation or antibiotics based on age/severity/diagnostic certainty; tubes for selected recurrent/persistent disease.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 近期病毒性上呼吸道感染

red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示乳突炎

red_flags_zh.finding: 嚴重頭痛或神經學徵象
red_flags_zh.rationale: 提示顱內併發症
提示嚴重感染

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發性感音神經性聽力損失型態
red_flags_zh.rationale: 須與傳導性聽力變化區分

red_flags_en.rationale: Suggests mastoiditis
Suggests intracranial complication
Suggests severe infection
Must be distinguished from conductive hearing change

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 在排除併發症紅旗後，可作為輔助照護
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不得於感染組織上針刺，須留意併發症與突發性聽力損失的鑑別
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 若使用抗生素治療，與病人的處方醫師聯絡確認治療進度

acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not needle through infected tissue or delay evaluation for complications/sudden hearing loss
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: If antibiotics are prescribed, contact the prescriber to confirm treatment progress

records.summary_zh: COVID-19 是 SARS-CoV-2 感染，病程範圍從無症狀感染到嚴重多重器官疾病及急性期後的長新冠。
records.summary_en: COVID-19 is infection caused by SARS-CoV-2, ranging from asymptomatic infection to critical multisystem disease and post-acute Long COVID.
records.etiology_zh: SARS-CoV-2 感染，主要透過呼吸道飛沫傳播。
records.etiology_en: SARS-CoV-2 infection transmitted primarily through respiratory particles.
records.western_pathology_zh: 病毒感染與宿主免疫反應影響呼吸道及其他器官系統；重症可造成低血氧性肺炎與血栓發炎併發症。
records.western_pathology_en: Viral infection and host immune response affect respiratory and other organ systems; severe disease can cause hypoxemic pneumonia and thromboinflammatory complications.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：與流感症狀重疊，僅憑症狀無法可靠區分兩者；急性感染與「長新冠」（見 cond.post_covid）為不同臨床階段，不應混為一談。

臨床表現：發燒畏寒、咳嗽、呼吸困難、疲勞、喉嚨痛、鼻塞、肌肉痠痛、頭痛、腸胃症狀及味嗅覺改變。

重要特徵：病毒檢測可確診、嚴重度範圍廣、符合條件之高風險門診病人可儘早使用抗病毒藥物、長新冠屬獨立的急性期後狀態。

診斷方法：核酸／抗原病毒檢測，並評估嚴重度。

鑑別診斷：流感、普通感冒、肺炎、肺栓塞、氣喘／慢性阻塞性肺病急性惡化。

西醫治療：低風險輕症以支持性療法為主；符合條件之高風險門診病人使用限時抗病毒藥物，重症依醫院準則處置。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: COVID-19 and influenza share symptoms but are caused by different viruses and cannot be reliably distinguished by symptoms alone; acute infection and 'Long COVID' (see cond.post_covid) are distinct clinical stages and should not be conflated.

Clinical presentation: Fever/chills, cough, dyspnea, fatigue, sore throat, congestion, myalgias, headache, GI symptoms and taste/smell change may occur.

Key features: viral testing confirms, severity spectrum broad, early outpatient antivirals for eligible high-risk patients, Long COVID is separate post-acute condition.

Diagnostic approach: NAAT/PCR or antigen viral testing plus severity evaluation.

Differential diagnosis: influenza, common cold, pneumonia, PE, asthma/COPD exacerbation.

Western treatment: Supportive care for low-risk mild disease; time-limited antiviral options for high-risk outpatients and hospital protocols for severe disease.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 若使用抗病毒藥物治療，與病人的處方醫師聯絡確認治療進度

records.summary_zh: 結核病是結核分枝桿菌複合群造成的活動性疾病，最常見於肺部，但可能侵犯幾乎任何器官。
records.summary_en: Tuberculosis disease is active illness caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex, most often pulmonary but potentially affecting nearly any organ.
records.etiology_zh: 結核分枝桿菌經由空氣傳播；免疫抑制與特定共病會提高由潛伏感染進展為活動性疾病的機率。
records.etiology_en: Airborne transmission of M. tuberculosis; progression from latent infection is more likely with immunosuppression and certain comorbidities.
records.western_pathology_zh: 分枝桿菌逃避／突破免疫圍堵，增殖並造成肉芽腫性組織損傷；肺部疾病可透過空氣傳播病原體。
records.western_pathology_en: Mycobacteria evade/overcome immune containment, multiply and create granulomatous tissue injury; pulmonary disease can transmit organisms through air.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：活動性結核病與潛伏結核感染為不同狀態——潛伏感染無症狀且不具傳染性，不應與活動性疾病混淆。

臨床表現：肺結核可出現持續 3 週以上的咳嗽、胸痛、痰／咳血、疲勞、體重減輕、發燒與夜間盜汗。

重要特徵：活動性與潛伏感染須區分、具空氣傳播感染管制意涵、屬於通報疾病、須以痰液／培養／分子檢測評估。

診斷方法：結核血液／皮膚檢測顯示感染但不能單獨診斷活動性疾病；須輔以胸部影像及痰液抹片／培養／分子檢測。

鑑別診斷：肺炎、肺癌、黴菌感染、類肉瘤病、潛伏結核感染。

西醫治療：依公共衛生／臨床指引使用多重抗生素治療；服藥遵從性與抗藥性檢測至為關鍵。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Active TB disease is distinct from latent/inactive TB infection: latent infection causes no symptoms and is not contagious.

Clinical presentation: Pulmonary TB can cause cough ≥3 weeks, chest pain, sputum/hemoptysis, fatigue, weight loss, fever and night sweats.

Key features: active vs latent distinction, airborne infection-control implications, reportable disease, sputum/culture/molecular testing.

Diagnostic approach: TB blood/skin test indicates infection but does not alone diagnose active disease; chest imaging and sputum smear/culture/molecular tests evaluate disease.

Differential diagnosis: pneumonia, lung cancer, fungal infection, sarcoidosis, latent TB.

Western treatment: Multi-drug antimicrobial therapy under public-health/clinical guidance; adherence and resistance testing are critical.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 萊姆病是由帶原黑腿蜱傳播的細菌性感染；未治療的感染可侵犯皮膚、關節、心臟與神經系統。
records.summary_en: Lyme disease is a bacterial infection transmitted by infected blacklegged ticks; untreated infection can involve skin, joints, heart and nervous system.
records.etiology_zh: 美國主要病原體為伯氏疏螺旋體，少數為 B. mayonii，由硬蜱屬（Ixodes）蜱傳播。
records.etiology_en: In the U.S., mainly Borrelia burgdorferi and rarely B. mayonii transmitted by Ixodes ticks.
records.western_pathology_zh: 局部感染可經血液／組織擴散，引發神經、心臟或關節表現。
records.western_pathology_en: Local infection can disseminate through blood/tissues and trigger neurologic, cardiac or joint manifestations.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：在適當暴露情境下出現遊走性紅斑可作為臨床診斷依據；單獨的非特異性慢性症狀不足以確立萊姆病診斷。

臨床表現：早期出現發燒、頭痛、疲勞與遊走性紅斑；後期可出現顏面麻痺、腦膜炎／神經根性疼痛、心臟傳導阻滯或關節炎。

重要特徵：蜱媒傳播、遊走性紅斑具高度診斷價值、指定情境下採兩步驟血清學檢測、可能出現神經／心臟併發症。

診斷方法：典型遊走性紅斑可臨床診斷；否則採 CDC 建議之兩步驟血清學檢測並依器官表現評估。

鑑別診斷：造成紅疹的蜂窩性組織炎／癬、其他病因之顏面神經麻痺、病毒性症候群、類風濕性關節炎、其他蜱媒疾病。

西醫治療：依臨床表現選擇適當口服或靜脈抗生素；早期治療可預防多數併發症。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Erythema migrans in an appropriate exposure context can be diagnostic; nonspecific chronic symptoms alone do not establish Lyme disease.

Clinical presentation: Fever, headache, fatigue and erythema migrans early; later facial palsy, meningitis/radicular pain, carditis/heart block or arthritis.

Key features: tick-borne, erythema migrans high-yield, two-step serology for indicated testing, neurologic/cardiac complications.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical diagnosis for classic EM; otherwise CDC-recommended two-step serology plus organ-specific evaluation.

Differential diagnosis: cellulitis/tinea for rash, Bell palsy other causes, viral syndrome, RA, other tick-borne disease.

Western treatment: Appropriate oral or IV antibiotics based on manifestation; early treatment prevents many complications.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.name_zh: 人類免疫缺乏病毒感染
records.summary_zh: HIV 是攻擊免疫系統的慢性病毒感染；未治療可能進展為愛滋病，而有效抗反轉錄病毒治療可抑制病毒複製並維持健康。
records.summary_en: HIV is a chronic viral infection that attacks the immune system; untreated infection can progress to AIDS, while effective antiretroviral therapy can suppress viral replication and preserve health.
records.etiology_zh: 透過特定體液傳播，包括性行為、血液及垂直傳染。
records.etiology_en: Transmission occurs through specific body fluids, including sexual, blood and perinatal routes.
records.western_pathology_zh: HIV 感染並耗損 CD4 免疫細胞，削弱宿主防禦能力，若未控制則增加伺機性感染風險。
records.western_pathology_en: HIV infects and depletes CD4 immune cells, impairing host defense and increasing opportunistic disease risk when uncontrolled.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：HIV 感染與愛滋病（第三期疾病）相關但不可互換，兩者為不同疾病階段。

臨床表現：急性感染可能出現類流感症狀或無症狀；慢性感染可能多年無症狀。

重要特徵：須經檢測才能得知感染狀態、確診者皆建議接受抗反轉錄病毒治療、病毒量受抑制可預防性傳染、伺機性感染風險依免疫狀態而定。

診斷方法：CDC 建議之 HIV 抗原／抗體及補充檢測流程；病毒量與 CD4 用於監測治療與疾病狀態。

鑑別診斷：其他急性病毒性疾病、原發性免疫缺乏、藥物相關血球低下。

西醫治療：確診後開始並持續合併抗反轉錄病毒治療；預防／治療伺機性感染並提供預防性照護。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: HIV infection and AIDS/stage 3 disease are related but not interchangeable identities.

Clinical presentation: Acute infection may cause flu-like illness or no symptoms; chronic infection can remain asymptomatic for years.

Key features: testing is required to know status, ART for all diagnosed people, viral suppression prevents sexual transmission, opportunistic risk depends on immune status.

Diagnostic approach: CDC HIV antigen/antibody and supplemental testing algorithms; viral load and CD4 monitor treatment/disease.

Differential diagnosis: other acute viral illnesses, primary immunodeficiency, medication-related cytopenia.

Western treatment: Start and maintain combination antiretroviral therapy; prevent/treat opportunistic infections and address preventive care.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 未使用防護措施之高風險性行為

acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Coordinate around immune status, neuropathy and medication interactions
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's infectious-disease/HIV clinician to coordinate care; do not advise the patient to stop antiretroviral therapy

records.summary_zh: 梅毒是由梅毒螺旋體引起的全身性性傳染疾病，未治療會歷經初期、二期、潛伏期與三期進展。
records.summary_en: Syphilis is a systemic sexually transmitted infection caused by Treponema pallidum that progresses through primary, secondary, latent and tertiary stages if untreated.
records.etiology_zh: 透過性行為傳染及懷孕期間垂直傳染；病原體為梅毒螺旋體。
records.etiology_en: Sexual transmission and vertical transmission during pregnancy; caused by T. pallidum.
records.western_pathology_zh: 螺旋體全身性擴散並可潛伏存在，之後侵犯神經、心血管及其他組織。
records.western_pathology_en: Spirochetes disseminate systemically and can persist latently, later injuring nervous, cardiovascular and other tissues.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：分期決定臨床表現、治療期程與追蹤方式；神經梅毒、眼梅毒與耳梅毒可能發生於任何分期。

臨床表現：初期出現無痛性硬性下疳；二期出現包含掌蹠之皮疹與全身症狀；潛伏期無症狀；三期出現神經／心血管／樹膠腫性病變。

重要特徵：分期性性傳染病、血清學檢測為主、盤尼西林治療可治癒、神經／眼／耳受累可能發生於任何分期。

診斷方法：血清學檢測，特定情況輔以病灶直接檢測；必要時進行腦脊髓液／眼／聽力評估。

鑑別診斷：其他生殖器潰瘍病因、病毒性皮疹、自體免疫性皮疹、其他造成神經／眼部疾病之病因。

西醫治療：依分期／表現選擇盤尼西林療程；性伴侶、懷孕及追蹤檢測須依指引處理。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Stage determines presentation, treatment duration and follow-up; neurosyphilis, ocular syphilis and otosyphilis can occur.

Clinical presentation: Primary painless chancre; secondary rash including palms/soles and systemic symptoms; latent asymptomatic; tertiary neurologic/cardiovascular/gummatous disease.

Key features: staged STI, serologic testing, curable with penicillin, neuro/ocular/otic involvement may occur at any stage.

Diagnostic approach: Serologic testing and direct lesion testing in selected cases; CSF/ocular/auditory assessment when indicated.

Differential diagnosis: other genital ulcers, viral exanthem, autoimmune rash, other causes of neuro/ocular disease.

Western treatment: Penicillin regimen depends on stage/manifestation; partners, pregnancy and follow-up testing require guideline-directed care.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 唐氏症是由第 21 對染色體多出的染色體物質造成的染色體疾患，伴隨特徵性的發展、認知與多重器官系統健康特徵。
records.summary_en: Down syndrome is a chromosomal condition caused by extra chromosome 21 material and is associated with characteristic developmental, cognitive and multisystem health features.
records.etiology_zh: 多出的第 21 對染色體物質，多數源自於隨機的細胞分裂錯誤；部分轉位型病例可能遺傳自帶有平衡性轉位的父母。
records.etiology_en: Extra chromosome 21 material, usually from a random cell-division error; some translocation cases can be inherited from a balanced-translocation parent.
records.western_pathology_zh: 基因劑量效應改變腦部、心臟、免疫、內分泌等多系統的發育。
records.western_pathology_en: Gene-dosage effects alter development across brain, heart, immune, endocrine and other systems.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：多數病例為第 21 對染色體之三染色體症；也存在轉位型與鑲嵌型。這是一種終身性遺傳疾患，需要個人化的健康監測，不是可以「治癒」的疾病。

臨床表現：程度不一之智能／發展障礙、肌張力低下與特徵性外觀；可能合併先天性心臟病、聽力、視力、甲狀腺、腸胃及血液系統相關疾患。

重要特徵：以第 21 對染色體三染色體症最常見、須多系統健康監測、個體差異大、先天性心臟病／聽力／甲狀腺風險提高。

診斷方法：產前篩檢／診斷性檢測，或出生後染色體分析確診。

鑑別診斷：其他染色體／發展性症候群。

西醫治療：無單一疾病治療方式；依個人狀況提供發展支持與終身各系統的預防／專科照護。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Most cases are trisomy 21 from nondisjunction; translocation and mosaic forms exist. It is not a disease to be 'cured' but a lifelong genetic condition requiring individualized health surveillance.

Clinical presentation: Variable intellectual/developmental disability, hypotonia and characteristic physical features; associated congenital heart, hearing, vision, thyroid, GI and hematologic conditions.

Key features: trisomy 21 most common form, multisystem surveillance, wide individual variation, increased congenital heart/hearing/thyroid risks.

Diagnostic approach: Prenatal screening/diagnostic testing or postnatal chromosome analysis confirms diagnosis.

Differential diagnosis: other chromosomal/developmental syndromes.

Western treatment: No single disease treatment; developmental supports and condition-specific preventive/specialty care throughout life.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 依相關器官系統病況轉診評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 唐氏症患者的先天性心臟病等共病可能影響急症表現與處置

red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 手法或運動治療前先轉診評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 部分個案頸椎不穩定會影響處置安全性

red_flags_en.finding: Acute symptoms (per the associated organ-system condition)
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Refer for evaluation per the relevant organ-system condition
red_flags_en.rationale: Congenital heart disease and other comorbidities in Down syndrome can affect emergency presentation and management

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Refer for evaluation before manual therapy or exercise
red_flags_en.rationale: Cervical instability can affect procedure/exercise safety in some individuals

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 治療前確認心臟、頸椎、感覺與溝通需求，不預設刻板印象
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的專科照護團隊（心臟科、聽力／視力等）聯絡確認共病狀態

acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Confirm cardiac, cervical-spine, sensory and communication needs without stereotyping
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's specialty care team (cardiology, hearing/vision, etc.) to confirm comorbidity status

acupuncture_scope_en.note: No acupuncture-specific efficacy guideline for Down syndrome was located; this is a scope-of-practice caution

records.summary_zh: 馬凡氏症候群是由 FBN1 基因變異造成的體染色體顯性結締組織疾患，可能影響主動脈、心臟瓣膜、眼睛與骨骼。
records.summary_en: Marfan syndrome is an autosomal-dominant connective-tissue disorder caused by FBN1 variants that can affect the aorta, heart valves, eyes and skeleton.
records.etiology_zh: FBN1 致病性基因變異；部分病例為遺傳，部分為新發突變。
records.etiology_en: Pathogenic variants in FBN1; some cases inherited and others de novo.
records.western_pathology_zh: 纖維蛋白-1／微纖維缺陷使結締組織強度減弱，並使生長因子訊號失調。
records.western_pathology_en: Defective fibrillin-1/microfibrils weaken connective tissue and dysregulate growth-factor signaling.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：主動脈根部病變與水晶體異位是主要診斷／處置重點特徵，表現型差異極大。

臨床表現：身材高瘦、指趾細長、骨骼變形、水晶體異位／近視、主動脈擴張／動脈瘤與瓣膜疾病。

重要特徵：FBN1 結締組織疾患、主動脈瘤／剝離風險、水晶體異位、體染色體顯性遺傳。

診斷方法：臨床 Ghent 準則、家族史、心血管／眼科評估及基因檢測。

鑑別診斷：Loeys-Dietz 症候群、血管型 Ehlers-Danlos 症候群、同半胱胺酸尿症、家族性胸主動脈瘤。

西醫治療：定期主動脈影像追蹤、血壓／心率管理，並於適當時機進行預防性主動脈手術；眼科／骨科照護。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Aortic-root disease and ectopia lentis are major diagnostic/management features; phenotype varies widely.

Clinical presentation: Tall/slender habitus, long digits, skeletal deformity, lens dislocation/myopia, aortic dilation/aneurysm and valve disease.

Key features: FBN1 connective-tissue disorder, aortic aneurysm/dissection risk, ectopia lentis, autosomal dominant.

Diagnostic approach: Clinical Ghent-style criteria, family history, cardiovascular/eye evaluation and genetic testing.

Differential diagnosis: Loeys-Dietz syndrome, vascular EDS, homocystinuria, familial thoracic aortic aneurysm.

Western treatment: Regular aortic imaging, blood-pressure/heart-rate management and prophylactic aortic surgery when indicated; eye/skeletal care.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 家族史（體染色體顯性遺傳）

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Immediate emergency evaluation for aortic dissection/rupture
red_flags_en.rationale: Marfan patients carry significantly elevated aortic risk

records.summary_zh: 癌症是一大類疾病的總稱，特徵為異常細胞不受控制地生長、侵犯組織並可能轉移；部位、組織學、分期與生物標記決定其臨床意義。此為總類導覽卡，不取代部位專屬的正典癌症卡片。
records.summary_en: Cancer is a large family of diseases in which abnormal cells grow uncontrollably, invade tissues and may metastasize. Site, histology, stage and biomarkers determine clinical meaning. This is a generic navigational parent card, not a replacement for site-specific canonical cancers.
records.etiology_zh: 癌症源自於累積的基因體／表觀基因體變異，受年齡、遺傳易感性、暴露因子、感染及隨機細胞歷程共同影響。
records.etiology_en: Cancer arises from accumulated genomic/epigenomic alterations influenced by age, inherited susceptibility, exposures, infections and random cellular processes.
records.western_pathology_zh: 惡性細胞逃脫生長調控、侵犯局部組織、招募血液供應，並可能經淋巴／血流擴散至遠處器官。
records.western_pathology_en: Malignant cells escape growth controls, invade local tissue, recruit blood supply and may spread through lymph/blood to distant organs.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：此總類卡用於導覽與跨科共同照護，不應取代部位專屬的正典癌症卡（如乳癌、攝護腺癌、大腸直腸癌、肺癌，見本批次其他卡片）。與 cond.cancer_supportive（腫瘤支持照護）為互補而非等同：後者聚焦症狀／副作用管理，本卡聚焦疾病本身的識別與分期邏輯。

臨床表現：因部位而異；可能出現不明原因持續腫塊、出血、體重減輕、疼痛、器官功能障礙，或篩檢時無症狀發現。

重要特徵：異質性疾病家族、多數診斷需組織病理確認、分期決定預後與治療、治療副作用為重要共同照護議題。

診斷方法：部位專屬之影像／內視鏡／檢驗，多數癌症接續進行組織診斷與分期。

鑑別診斷：良性腫瘤、感染／發炎、部位專屬之類似病灶。

西醫治療：依癌症種類／分期選擇手術、放射治療、全身性治療（細胞毒性、內分泌、標靶、免疫治療）及支持性／緩和照護。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須依部位、組織學及當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: A generic cancer parent is useful for navigation/co-management but should not replace site-specific canonical cancers (breast, prostate, colorectal, lung — see other cards in this batch). Complementary to, not equivalent to, cond.cancer_supportive (cancer supportive care): that card focuses on symptom/side-effect management, this card focuses on identifying and staging the disease itself.

Clinical presentation: Varies by site; unexplained persistent masses, bleeding, weight loss, pain, organ dysfunction or no symptoms on screening.

Key features: heterogeneous disease family, biopsy/pathology defines many diagnoses, stage drives prognosis/treatment, treatment adverse effects are major co-management issue.

Diagnostic approach: Site-specific imaging/endoscopy/labs followed by tissue diagnosis in many cancers and staging.

Differential diagnosis: benign tumors, infection/inflammation, site-specific mimics.

Western treatment: Surgery, radiation, systemic therapy (cytotoxic, endocrine, targeted, immunotherapy) and supportive/palliative care based on cancer type/stage.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection depends on site, histology and the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review.

acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 須留意嗜中性白血球低下、血小板低下與抗凝血狀態對針刺安全性的影響
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與病人的腫瘤科醫師聯絡確認治療階段與血球數值狀態

acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Contact the patient's oncologist to confirm treatment phase and blood count status

records.summary_zh: 乳癌是發生於乳房組織的惡性腫瘤，最常源自導管或小葉上皮，具多種生物學亞型。
records.summary_en: Breast cancer is malignant growth arising in breast tissue, most commonly from ductal or lobular epithelium, with diverse biologic subtypes.
records.etiology_zh: 風險反映年齡、性別、遺傳變異／家族史，以及生殖／荷爾蒙與生活型態／暴露因子。
records.etiology_en: Risk reflects age, sex, inherited variants/family history, reproductive/hormonal and lifestyle/exposure factors.
records.western_pathology_zh: 惡性乳房細胞侵犯周圍組織，並可能擴散至局部淋巴結及遠處器官。
records.western_pathology_en: Malignant breast cells invade surrounding tissue and can spread to regional nodes and distant organs.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：包含原位與侵犯性病灶及分子亞型；良性乳房腫塊不是癌症。

臨床表現：多由篩檢發現；可能出現乳房／腋下腫塊、皮膚／乳頭變化、分泌物或形狀改變。早期病灶可能無症狀。

重要特徵：篩檢可偵測無症狀疾病、組織切片為診斷依據、ER／PR／HER2 生物標記具重要意義、分期／亞型決定治療。

診斷方法：適當之診斷性乳房攝影／超音波／MRI，隨後進行切片與受體／病理檢測；必要時進行分期。

鑑別診斷：纖維腺瘤、囊腫、乳腺炎、良性乳房變化。

西醫治療：依亞型／分期選擇手術、放射治療及全身性內分泌、化療、HER2 標靶或其他標靶／免疫治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Breast cancer includes in-situ and invasive entities and molecular subtypes; benign breast lumps are not cancer.

Clinical presentation: Often screen-detected; possible breast/axillary lump, skin/nipple changes, discharge or shape change. Early disease may be asymptomatic.

Key features: screening detects asymptomatic disease, tissue biopsy diagnosis, ER/PR/HER2 biomarkers matter, stage/subtype guide treatment.

Diagnostic approach: Diagnostic mammography/ultrasound/MRI as appropriate followed by biopsy and receptor/pathology testing; staging when indicated.

Differential diagnosis: fibroadenoma, cyst, mastitis, benign breast change.

Western treatment: Surgery, radiation and systemic endocrine, chemotherapy, HER2-targeted or other targeted/immunotherapies according to subtype/stage.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 攝護腺癌是發生於攝護腺的惡性腫瘤，多為腺癌，病程從惰性局限性疾病到轉移性癌症不等。
records.summary_en: Prostate cancer is malignancy arising in the prostate, commonly adenocarcinoma, ranging from indolent localized disease to metastatic cancer.
records.etiology_zh: 年齡、家族／遺傳因子及族裔背景影響風險。
records.etiology_en: Age, family/genetic factors and ancestry influence risk.
records.western_pathology_zh: 惡性攝護腺上皮細胞可能維持局限，也可能擴散，常見轉移至骨骼與淋巴結。
records.western_pathology_en: Malignant prostate epithelial cells may remain localized or spread, commonly to bone and lymph nodes.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：攝護腺癌與良性攝護腺增生（cond.bph）及攝護腺炎（cond.chronic_prostatitis）為不同疾病；泌尿症狀不具特異性，不能用以區分三者。

臨床表現：早期常無症狀；晚期可能出現泌尿症狀、血尿／血精，或持續性骨盆／骨骼疼痛。

重要特徵：多數生長緩慢但具異質性、PSA 本身不具診斷性、切片為確診依據、部分低風險個案適合主動監測。

診斷方法：PSA／肛門指診風險評估、攝護腺 MRI 及切片；依風險程度進行分期影像。

鑑別診斷：良性攝護腺增生、攝護腺炎、泌尿道感染、其他癌症之骨骼轉移。

西醫治療：依分期／風險選擇主動監測、手術、放射治療、雄性素剝奪／荷爾蒙治療及全身性治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Prostate cancer is distinct from BPH and prostatitis; urinary symptoms are not specific.

Clinical presentation: Often asymptomatic early; advanced disease may cause urinary symptoms, hematuria/hematospermia or persistent bone/pelvic pain.

Key features: often slow-growing but heterogeneous, PSA is not diagnostic alone, biopsy defines cancer, active surveillance appropriate for selected low-risk disease.

Diagnostic approach: PSA/DRE risk assessment, prostate MRI and biopsy; staging imaging based on risk.

Differential diagnosis: BPH, prostatitis, UTI, metastatic bone disease from other cancer.

Western treatment: Active surveillance, surgery, radiation, androgen-deprivation/hormonal therapy and systemic treatments based on stage/risk.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 大腸直腸癌是發生於結腸或直腸的惡性腫瘤，多經由前驅性息肉發展而成，預後與分期高度相關。
records.summary_en: Colorectal cancer is malignancy arising in the colon or rectum, often developing through precursor polyps and with outcomes strongly influenced by stage.
records.etiology_zh: 年齡、遺傳症候群／家族史、發炎性腸道疾病及生活型態／代謝因子皆有影響。
records.etiology_en: Age, inherited syndromes/family history, IBD and lifestyle/metabolic factors contribute.
records.western_pathology_zh: 腺瘤性或鋸齒狀前驅病灶累積分子變異，逐漸進展為侵犯性與轉移性疾病。
records.western_pathology_en: Adenomatous or serrated precursor pathways accumulate molecular alterations, progressing to invasive and metastatic disease.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：與 cond.ibd（發炎性腸道疾病）為不同疾病，但長期發炎性腸道疾病是危險因子之一；良性息肉不是癌症。

臨床表現：篩檢可能發現無症狀病灶；可出現血便、排便習慣改變、缺鐵性貧血、腹痛或體重減輕。

重要特徵：篩檢／預防具重要性、息肉為前驅病灶、缺鐵性貧血可為線索、需組織診斷並分期。

診斷方法：大腸鏡併切片；CT／MRI 及腫瘤標記輔助分期與追蹤，非單獨診斷依據。

鑑別診斷：發炎性腸道疾病、痔瘡、憩室疾病、腸躁症、其他消化道出血病因。

西醫治療：手術合併依分期／部位選擇之化學治療、放射治療（尤其直腸個案）及標靶／免疫治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Distinct from cond.ibd (inflammatory bowel disease), though long-standing IBD is a risk factor; benign polyps are not cancer.

Clinical presentation: May be asymptomatic on screening; blood in stool, change in bowel habits, iron-deficiency anemia, abdominal pain or weight loss can occur.

Key features: screening/prevention important, polyps precursor, iron-deficiency anemia can be clue, tissue diagnosis + staging.

Diagnostic approach: Colonoscopy with biopsy; CT/MRI and tumor markers support staging/follow-up, not standalone diagnosis.

Differential diagnosis: IBD, hemorrhoids, diverticular disease, IBS, other GI bleeding causes.

Western treatment: Surgery plus stage/site-specific chemotherapy, radiation (especially rectal contexts) and targeted/immunotherapy based on tumor features.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 肺癌是發生於肺部組織的惡性疾病，主要分為非小細胞肺癌與小細胞肺癌，生物特性與治療方式不同。
records.summary_en: Lung cancer is malignant disease arising in lung tissue, broadly divided into non-small cell and small cell lung cancer with different biology and treatment.
records.etiology_zh: 菸草煙霧為主要危險因子；氡氣、職業／環境暴露及遺傳因子亦有影響，非吸菸者也可能罹患肺癌。
records.etiology_en: Tobacco smoke is a major risk factor; radon, occupational/environmental exposures and genetic factors also contribute, and nonsmokers can develop lung cancer.
records.western_pathology_zh: 惡性肺部細胞侵犯局部結構，並可能擴散至淋巴結、腦部、骨骼、肝臟等部位。
records.western_pathology_en: Malignant pulmonary cells invade local structures and spread to nodes, brain, bone, liver and other sites.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：持續性咳嗽或肺部結節不必然等於肺癌，須以組織學與分期確立診斷。

臨床表現：可能無症狀；持續／改變性咳嗽、咳血、胸痛、呼吸困難、體重減輕、聲音沙啞或反覆肺炎可能出現。

重要特徵：非小細胞肺癌與小細胞肺癌區分、符合條件之高風險族群可進行低劑量電腦斷層篩檢、須切片／分子檢測、有特定轉移型態。

診斷方法：胸部影像後接續組織診斷；分期與分子生物標記檢測指引治療。

鑑別診斷：肺炎、結核病、良性肺結節、慢性阻塞性肺病、其他癌症之肺轉移。

西醫治療：依組織學／分期／生物標記選擇手術、放射治療、化學治療、標靶治療及免疫治療。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Persistent cough or a lung nodule is not automatically cancer; histology and stage define disease.

Clinical presentation: May be asymptomatic; persistent/change in cough, hemoptysis, chest pain, dyspnea, weight loss, hoarseness or recurrent pneumonia can occur.

Key features: NSCLC vs SCLC, screening LDCT for eligible high-risk people, biopsy/molecular testing, metastatic patterns.

Diagnostic approach: Chest imaging followed by tissue diagnosis; staging and molecular biomarker testing guide treatment.

Differential diagnosis: pneumonia, TB, benign pulmonary nodule, COPD, metastatic cancer.

Western treatment: Surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, targeted therapy and immunotherapy based on histology/stage/biomarkers.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

red_flags_zh.rationale: 妊娠感染與出血需產科風險評估
red_flags_zh.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

red_flags_en.finding: Pelvic/lower abdominal pain with fever, nausea, or cervical-motion tenderness
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day assessment for PID and appropriate treatment
red_flags_en.rationale: Ascending infection can harm fertility or cause systemic illness
red_flags_en.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

red_flags_en.finding: Bleeding, pain, or suspected infection during pregnancy
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Contact obstetric care the same day
red_flags_en.rationale: Infection and bleeding in pregnancy require obstetric risk assessment
red_flags_en.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 針灸不能清除感染；可在抗感染處置後輔助處理疼痛或焦慮，但不可延誤檢測與伴侶管理。不能根除感染、替代抗生素或完成伴侶治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 急性感染、發燒或未明出血時暫緩；不在發炎生殖器區域操作。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與婦科／性健康服務共同管理，確保檢測、抗生素及伴侶處置。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Acupuncture cannot clear infection; after infectious management it may support pain or anxiety but must not delay testing or partner management. Cannot eradicate infection, replace antibiotics, or provide partner treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Defer with acute infection, fever, or unexplained bleeding; do not needle inflamed genital tissue.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with gynecology/sexual-health services for testing, antibiotics, and partner management.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

records.summary_zh: 子宮頸表面細胞的癌前異常，通常依活檢分為 CIN 1–3；不是癌症，但高級別病變可能進展。
records.summary_en: Precancerous abnormality of cervical surface cells, generally graded CIN 1–3 on biopsy; it is not cancer, but high-grade disease can progress.
records.western_context_zh: 子宮頸表面細胞的癌前異常，通常依活檢分為 CIN 1–3；不是癌症，但高級別病變可能進展。
records.western_context_en: Precancerous abnormality of cervical surface cells, generally graded CIN 1–3 on biopsy; it is not cancer, but high-grade disease can progress.
records.western_pathology_zh: 持續高危型 HPV 感染可導致子宮頸細胞逐步出現異型與上皮內病變。
records.western_pathology_en: Persistent high-risk HPV infection can drive progressive cellular atypia and intraepithelial lesions of the cervix.
records.etiology_zh: 持續高危型 HPV 感染可導致子宮頸細胞逐步出現異型與上皮內病變。
records.etiology_en: Persistent high-risk HPV infection can drive progressive cellular atypia and intraepithelial lesions of the cervix.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 持續高危型 HPV 感染

red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速婦科評估，不以針灸處理出血
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除侵襲癌或其他婦科病因
red_flags_zh.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

red_flags_zh.finding: 追蹤活檢或切除治療逾期
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速聯絡婦科完成風險分層與處置
red_flags_zh.rationale: 高級別病變可能進展且常無症狀
red_flags_zh.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain prompt gynecologic assessment; do not treat the bleeding with acupuncture
red_flags_en.rationale: Invasive cancer or another gynecologic cause must be excluded
red_flags_en.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

red_flags_en.finding: Overdue biopsy follow-up or excisional treatment
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Contact gynecology promptly for risk stratification and management
red_flags_en.rationale: High-grade lesions can progress and are often asymptomatic
red_flags_en.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不能治療或清除 CIN／HPV；僅可處理檢查或手術前後的焦慮、疼痛等輔助症狀。不能清除高危型 HPV、逆轉 CIN 或預防癌症進展。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不得針刺活動性出血或感染區；術後依婦科限制調整。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 必須由婦科依 HPV、細胞學與活檢結果持續追蹤。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Cannot treat or clear CIN/HPV; it may only support anxiety, pain, or other symptoms around evaluation and procedures. Cannot clear high-risk HPV, reverse CIN, or prevent cancer progression.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not needle through active bleeding or infection; follow post-procedure gynecologic restrictions.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Ongoing gynecologic follow-up based on HPV, cytology, and biopsy findings is required.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

records.summary_zh: 妊娠中期子宮頸可能在缺乏明顯宮縮下提早縮短或擴張，增加晚期流產與早產風險。
records.summary_en: Premature cervical shortening or dilation in mid-pregnancy, often without clear contractions, increasing risk of late miscarriage and preterm birth.
records.western_context_zh: 妊娠中期子宮頸可能在缺乏明顯宮縮下提早縮短或擴張，增加晚期流產與早產風險。
records.western_context_en: Premature cervical shortening or dilation in mid-pregnancy, often without clear contractions, increasing risk of late miscarriage and preterm birth.
records.western_pathology_zh: 子宮頸結構或功能無法在妊娠負荷下維持閉合；診斷依病史、檢查與超音波綜合判斷。
records.western_pathology_en: Cervical structure or function fails to remain closed under pregnancy load; diagnosis integrates history, examination, and ultrasound.
records.etiology_zh: 子宮頸結構或功能無法在妊娠負荷下維持閉合；診斷依病史、檢查與超音波綜合判斷。
records.etiology_en: Cervical structure or function fails to remain closed under pregnancy load; diagnosis integrates history, examination, and ultrasound.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 既往無痛性妊娠中期流產或早產
既往子宮頸手術或創傷
先天性子宮或子宮頸異常

risk_factors_en.factor: Prior painless mid-trimester loss or preterm birth

red_flags_zh.finding: 陰道大量流水、出血、規律宮縮或骨盆壓力增加
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即聯絡產科分娩單位接受當日評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為破水、早產或子宮頸進一步擴張

red_flags_zh.finding: 發燒、惡臭分泌物或劇烈腹痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為羊膜腔感染或其他妊娠急症

red_flags_en.finding: Gush of fluid, bleeding, regular contractions, or increasing pelvic pressure
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Contact obstetric triage immediately for same-day assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate membrane rupture, preterm labor, or further cervical dilation

red_flags_en.finding: Fever, foul discharge, or severe abdominal pain
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate intra-amniotic infection or another pregnancy emergency

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 針灸不能加固子宮頸或預防早產；只有產科明確同意時才可輔助處理一般妊娠不適。不能使子宮頸閉合、替代環紮或預防早產。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 疑似宮縮、出血、破水或感染時不治療；避免任何可能刺激子宮活動的處置。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 由高危產科／母胎醫學決定超音波監測、黃體素或環紮等管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: RCOG — Cervical stitch
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Acupuncture cannot reinforce the cervix or prevent preterm birth; it may support ordinary pregnancy discomfort only with explicit obstetric agreement. Cannot close the cervix, replace cerclage, or prevent preterm birth.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not treat when contractions, bleeding, membrane rupture, or infection is suspected; avoid any intervention that may stimulate uterine activity.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Maternal-fetal medicine/obstetrics directs ultrasound surveillance, progesterone, cerclage, or other management.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: RCOG — Cervical stitch
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

records.name_zh: 三角纖維軟骨複合體損傷

records.summary_zh: 由頸椎或頸部軟組織病變轉移至頭部的次發性頭痛，通常與頸部活動受限或特定動作誘發相關。
records.summary_en: A secondary headache referred from cervical spine or neck soft-tissue pathology, often associated with restricted neck motion or provocation by specific movement.
records.western_context_zh: 由頸椎或頸部軟組織病變轉移至頭部的次發性頭痛，通常與頸部活動受限或特定動作誘發相關。
records.western_context_en: A secondary headache referred from cervical spine or neck soft-tissue pathology, often associated with restricted neck motion or provocation by specific movement.
records.western_pathology_zh: 上頸段結構的傷害性輸入在三叉神經－頸髓複合體匯聚，使疼痛被感知於頭部。
records.western_pathology_en: Nociceptive input from upper cervical structures converges in the trigeminocervical complex, producing pain perceived in the head.
records.etiology_zh: 上頸段結構的傷害性輸入在三叉神經－頸髓複合體匯聚，使疼痛被感知於頭部。
records.etiology_en: Nociceptive input from upper cervical structures converges in the trigeminocervical complex, producing pain perceived in the head.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 持續受限姿勢與頸部負荷

risk_factors_en.factor: Sustained constrained posture and neck loading

red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除蛛網膜下腔出血等危急原因

red_flags_zh.finding: 發燒、癌症史、進行性神經缺損或近期重大外傷
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 停止常規治療並儘速醫療評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為感染、腫瘤、骨折或脊髓／神經病變

red_flags_en.rationale: A critical cause such as subarachnoid hemorrhage must be excluded

red_flags_en.finding: Fever, cancer history, progressive neurologic deficit, or recent major trauma
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Stop routine treatment and obtain prompt medical assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate infection, tumor, fracture, or spinal/neurologic disease

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可作為已排除危險病因後之疼痛與頸部功能管理的輔助手段；不可用標籤掩蓋其他次發性頭痛。不能在未排除危險次發病因前把頭痛視為單純肌骨疼痛。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 先做神經與頸椎安全篩檢；疑不穩定、骨折、血管病變或脊髓病時避免頸部強刺激。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 持續或非典型病例與基層醫療、神經科或物理治療共同管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AMF — What Is Cervicogenic Headache?
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May be an adjunct for pain and neck-function management after dangerous causes are excluded; the label must not obscure another secondary headache. Cannot treat the headache as uncomplicated musculoskeletal pain before dangerous secondary causes are excluded.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Screen neurologic and cervical safety first; avoid strong cervical stimulation when instability, fracture, vascular disease, or myelopathy is possible.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage persistent or atypical cases with primary care, neurology, or physical therapy.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AMF — What Is Cervicogenic Headache?
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

records.summary_zh: 胰臟反覆或持續發炎造成不可逆纖維化，導致慢性腹痛、消化酵素不足、營養不良與糖尿病。
records.summary_en: Repeated or persistent pancreatic inflammation causing irreversible fibrosis, chronic abdominal pain, exocrine insufficiency, malnutrition, and diabetes.
records.western_context_zh: 胰臟反覆或持續發炎造成不可逆纖維化，導致慢性腹痛、消化酵素不足、營養不良與糖尿病。
records.western_context_en: Repeated or persistent pancreatic inflammation causing irreversible fibrosis, chronic abdominal pain, exocrine insufficiency, malnutrition, and diabetes.
records.western_pathology_zh: 持續損傷啟動發炎與纖維化，逐步破壞胰臟外分泌與內分泌功能。
records.western_pathology_en: Ongoing injury drives inflammation and fibrosis, progressively destroying exocrine and endocrine pancreatic function.
records.etiology_zh: 持續損傷啟動發炎與纖維化，逐步破壞胰臟外分泌與內分泌功能。
records.etiology_en: Ongoing injury drives inflammation and fibrosis, progressively destroying exocrine and endocrine pancreatic function.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 胰管阻塞、高三酸甘油酯或高血鈣

red_flags_zh.finding: 突然加劇的持續上腹痛、反覆嘔吐或發燒
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為急性胰臟炎、感染或阻塞

red_flags_zh.finding: 黃疸、昏厥、低血糖意識改變或消化道出血
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為膽道阻塞、代謝急症或出血

red_flags_en.finding: Suddenly worse persistent upper-abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, or fever
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day emergency or medical assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate acute pancreatitis, infection, or obstruction

red_flags_en.finding: Jaundice, syncope, altered mental status from hypoglycemia, or GI bleeding
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate biliary obstruction, metabolic emergency, or bleeding

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可輔助穩定期疼痛、噁心或壓力管理；不可取代酵素、營養、糖尿病與併發症治療。不能逆轉胰臟纖維化或取代酵素、營養與糖尿病治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 急性劇痛、嘔吐、發燒、黃疸或脫水時不治療；避免在壓痛腹部強刺激。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與胃腸科、疼痛、營養與內分泌團隊共同管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: NIDDK — Symptoms & Causes of Pancreatitis
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May support stable pain, nausea, or stress management; it cannot replace enzyme, nutrition, diabetes, or complication treatment. Cannot reverse pancreatic fibrosis or replace enzyme, nutrition, and diabetes treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Defer during acute severe pain, vomiting, fever, jaundice, or dehydration; avoid strong stimulation over a tender abdomen.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with gastroenterology, pain, nutrition, and endocrine teams.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: NIDDK — Symptoms & Causes of Pancreatitis
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

records.summary_zh: 憩室病是結腸壁形成囊狀突出（憩室）；當憩室造成症狀、出血、發炎或其他併發症時稱為憩室病，其中因憩室發炎所致者稱為憩室炎。
records.summary_en: Diverticular disease refers to sac-like outpouchings (diverticula) in the colon wall; when diverticula cause symptoms, bleeding, inflammation, or other complications the condition is called diverticular disease, and inflammation of diverticula is specifically termed diverticulitis.
records.western_pathology_zh: 憩室由結腸壁薄弱處向外突出形成，好發於乙狀結腸；當憩室出血、發炎、穿孔、形成膿瘍或瘻管，或造成腸道阻塞時便產生臨床症狀與併發症。低纖維高紅肉飲食、活動量不足、肥胖、吸菸與部分藥物（如 NSAIDs、類固醇）可能增加發炎或併發症風險；結腸腔內滯留的細菌或糞便、腸道菌相改變、結締組織／肌肉／神經功能異常及免疫失調也在研究中，確切機轉尚未完全釐清。
records.western_pathology_en: Diverticula are outpouchings that form at weak points in the colon wall, most often in the sigmoid colon; symptoms and complications arise when diverticula bleed, become inflamed, perforate, form an abscess or fistula, or cause obstruction. A diet low in fiber and high in red meat, lack of physical activity, obesity, smoking, and certain medicines (e.g., NSAIDs, steroids) may raise the risk of inflammation or complications; trapped bacteria or stool within the colon, microbiome changes, abnormalities of connective tissue/muscle/nerves in the colon wall, and immune dysfunction are also under investigation, and the exact mechanism is not fully established.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：無症狀憩室症、有症狀的憩室病與發炎性的憩室炎是連續的臨床狀態，並非同一件事；本卡涵蓋憩室病與憩室炎。

臨床表現：下腹痛或絞痛，常在左下腹；可有便祕、腹瀉或腹脹；憩室炎常出現較明顯的局部腹痛，可伴發燒、畏寒、噁心或嘔吐；直腸出血、發燒、腹膜刺激徵（反彈痛、腹部僵硬）或全身性不適提示併發症風險。

重要特徵：好發於乙狀結腸；多數憩室終生無症狀；憩室炎需與單純憩室症狀區分；出血可為急性大量出血；並非每位單純性憩室炎患者都必須使用抗生素。

診斷方法：病史與腹部理學檢查；視情況安排血液與糞便檢查；依臨床表現使用電腦斷層、超音波或核磁共振；急性問題處理後以大腸鏡確認病變並排除其他疾病，亦可用於處理憩室出血。

鑑別診斷：大腸激躁症、發炎性腸道疾病、大腸癌、缺血性腸炎、婦科疾病、泌尿道感染。

西醫治療：依慢性症狀、急性單純性憩室炎或併發症分層治療；部分單純性憩室炎可保守處理並門診追蹤；重症、膿瘍、穿孔、瘻管或阻塞可能需住院、影像導引引流、內視鏡止血或手術；長期以足量纖維飲食與生活型態調整降低復發風險。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Asymptomatic diverticulosis, symptomatic diverticular disease, and diverticulitis (inflammation) form a clinical continuum rather than one single state; this card covers diverticular disease and diverticulitis.

Clinical presentation: Lower abdominal pain or cramping, often left-sided; constipation, diarrhea, or bloating may occur; diverticulitis tends to cause more localized pain and may include fever, chills, nausea, or vomiting; rectal bleeding, fever, peritoneal signs (rebound tenderness, guarding), or systemic illness suggest a complication.

Key features: most common in the sigmoid colon; most diverticula remain asymptomatic for life; diverticulitis must be distinguished from uncomplicated diverticular symptoms; bleeding can be acute and substantial; not every patient with uncomplicated diverticulitis requires antibiotics.

Diagnostic approach: History and abdominal exam; blood and stool testing as indicated; CT, ultrasound, or MRI depending on presentation; colonoscopy after the acute episode resolves to confirm findings and exclude other disease, which can also address diverticular bleeding.

Differential diagnosis: irritable bowel syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, colorectal cancer, ischemic colitis, gynecologic disease, urinary tract infection.

Western treatment: Management is stratified by chronic symptoms, uncomplicated acute diverticulitis, or complications; some uncomplicated diverticulitis can be managed conservatively with outpatient follow-up; severe disease, abscess, perforation, fistula, or obstruction may require hospitalization, image-guided drainage, endoscopic hemostasis, or surgery; long-term adequate-fiber diet and lifestyle changes reduce recurrence risk.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 乳糜瀉是在遺傳易感族群中由飲食麩質觸發的免疫介導疾病，可損傷小腸黏膜，產生腸胃道及腸外表現。
records.summary_en: Celiac disease is an immune-mediated disease triggered by dietary gluten in genetically susceptible people; it can damage the small-intestinal lining and produce both gastrointestinal and extra-intestinal manifestations.
records.western_pathology_zh: 麩質暴露在帶有 HLA-DQ2 或 HLA-DQ8 基因型的個體中引發異常免疫反應，攻擊並損傷小腸黏膜絨毛，造成絨毛萎縮、吸收不良、營養缺乏與全身性表現。約 95% 乳糜瀉患者帶有 HLA-DQ2，其餘多帶 HLA-DQ8；然而這兩種基因型在一般族群相當常見（約三分之一美國人口帶有其一），僅其中一小部分會發病，顯示其他基因與環境因子（如嬰幼兒期麩質攝取量、腸道感染、腸道菌相改變）也參與致病機轉。
records.western_pathology_en: Gluten exposure triggers an abnormal immune response in people carrying HLA-DQ2 or HLA-DQ8, which attacks and damages the small-intestinal villi, causing villous atrophy, malabsorption, nutrient deficiencies, and systemic manifestations. About 95% of people with celiac disease carry HLA-DQ2 and most of the rest carry HLA-DQ8; however these gene variants are common in the general population (up to one-third of the US population carries one), and only a small fraction of carriers develop disease — indicating other genetic and environmental factors (such as gluten intake in early childhood, digestive-tract infections, and microbiome changes) also contribute.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：乳糜瀉是免疫介導疾病，不是食物過敏，也不是單純的麩質敏感；未經診斷或未嚴格治療可造成長期腸道與腸外併發症。

臨床表現：腹瀉、腹脹、腹痛等腸胃症狀；體重減輕或兒童生長遲緩；腸外表現可包括缺鐵性貧血、骨骼問題、疱疹樣皮膚炎、口腔／牙齒琺瑯質缺損或神經症狀（頭痛、癲癇、平衡障礙）；部分患者僅有腸外表現或無症狀；單靠症狀不足以確診。

重要特徵：約 95% 患者帶有 HLA-DQ2、其餘多帶 HLA-DQ8，但帶因不等於發病；兒童可有生長遲緩、發育遲緩、青春期延遲；小腸黏膜損傷可繼發乳糖不耐；長期未治療與不孕、流產等生殖問題相關。

診斷方法：血清學檢測，常以組織轉麩醯胺酸酶 IgA（tTG-IgA）並評估 IgA 總量狀態；有適應症時以小腸切片確認診斷；診斷檢測應在患者仍攝取麩質時完成，否則可能偽陰性；特定情況可用基因檢測（HLA-DQ2/DQ8）協助排除診斷。

鑑別診斷：大腸激躁症、發炎性腸道疾病、乳糖不耐症、小腸細菌過度增生、其他吸收不良症候群。

西醫治療：終身嚴格無麩質飲食是唯一治療；由營養師協助辨識隱藏麩質來源並維持營養完整；評估與矯正鐵、鈣、維生素 D 等營養缺乏並追蹤黏膜恢復；症狀持續時重新評估是否仍有麩質暴露、其他共病診斷或難治型乳糜瀉。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Celiac disease is immune-mediated, not a food allergy and not the same as non-celiac gluten sensitivity; undiagnosed or inadequately treated disease can cause long-term intestinal and extra-intestinal complications.

Clinical presentation: GI symptoms such as diarrhea, bloating, and abdominal pain; weight loss or growth faltering in children; extra-intestinal manifestations can include iron-deficiency anemia, bone problems, dermatitis herpetiformis, dental enamel defects, or neurologic symptoms (headache, seizures, balance problems); some patients have only extra-intestinal findings or are asymptomatic; symptoms alone are not sufficient for diagnosis.

Key features: about 95% of patients carry HLA-DQ2 and most of the rest HLA-DQ8, but carrying the gene does not mean disease will develop; children may show growth faltering, developmental delay, or delayed puberty; small-intestinal mucosal damage can cause secondary lactose intolerance; long-standing untreated disease is associated with infertility and miscarriage.

Diagnostic approach: Serologic testing, typically tTG-IgA with assessment of total IgA status; small-bowel biopsy to confirm when indicated; diagnostic testing should be completed while the patient is still eating gluten, or results may be falsely negative; genetic testing (HLA-DQ2/DQ8) can help rule out the diagnosis in selected situations.

Differential diagnosis: irritable bowel syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, lactose intolerance, small intestinal bacterial overgrowth, other malabsorptive syndromes.

Western treatment: Lifelong strict gluten-free diet is the only treatment; a dietitian helps identify hidden gluten sources and maintain nutritional adequacy; nutrient deficiencies (iron, calcium, vitamin D, etc.) are assessed and corrected, and mucosal recovery is followed; persistent symptoms prompt reassessment for ongoing gluten exposure, other diagnoses, or refractory celiac disease.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.

records.summary_zh: 乳糖不耐是因乳糖吸收不良，攝取乳糖後出現消化症狀；單純乳糖吸收不良而無症狀不等於乳糖不耐。
records.summary_en: Lactose intolerance is the occurrence of digestive symptoms after consuming lactose, caused by lactose malabsorption; lactose malabsorption without symptoms alone does not equal lactose intolerance.
records.western_pathology_zh: 小腸乳糖酶活性不足（乳糖酶缺乏）使乳糖無法完全消化；未吸收的乳糖進入結腸後被細菌發酵，並增加腸腔滲透負荷，因而產生脹氣、腹痛與腹瀉。乳糖吸收不良在全球約影響三分之二人口，但並非所有吸收不良者都會出現症狀。乳糖酶缺乏可能是原發性（隨年齡自然下降，具族群差異）或續發性（因小腸疾病或損傷造成，如乳糜瀉、克隆氏症、腸道感染或手術後）。
records.western_pathology_en: Insufficient small-intestinal lactase activity (lactase deficiency) prevents complete digestion of lactose; undigested lactose passes into the colon, is fermented by bacteria, and increases the osmotic load in the bowel lumen, producing gas, cramping, and diarrhea. Lactose malabsorption affects roughly two-thirds of the world's population, but not everyone with malabsorption develops symptoms. Lactase deficiency may be primary (a natural age-related decline that varies by ancestry) or secondary (caused by small-intestinal disease or injury such as celiac disease, Crohn's disease, intestinal infection, or bowel surgery).
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：乳糖不耐是乳糖吸收不良合併症狀，須與牛奶蛋白過敏區分——過敏牽涉免疫機轉且可有全身性反應，乳糖不耐是消化酵素不足的問題。

臨床表現：攝取乳糖後出現腹脹、腹瀉、排氣增加、噁心、腹痛或腸鳴；症狀程度依乳糖攝取量與個人耐受度而異，通常於攝取後數十分鐘至數小時內出現。

重要特徵：美國境內非裔、美洲原住民、亞裔與拉丁裔族群乳糖吸收不良比例較高，歐洲裔族群最低；原發性乳糖酶缺乏隨年齡增加而更常見；續發性乳糖酶缺乏來自小腸疾病或損傷，原發病因處理後可能改善。

診斷方法：病史確認症狀與乳糖攝取的時間關係；減少乳糖飲食試驗可協助評估；需要確認診斷時可使用氫氣呼氣試驗；症狀持續、不典型或合併體重減輕、血便等表現時，須評估其他腸胃疾病。

鑑別診斷：牛奶蛋白過敏、乳糜瀉、大腸激躁症、發炎性腸道疾病、小腸細菌過度增生。

西醫治療：依個人耐受度調整乳糖攝取，不應一律假設必須完全避免乳製品；乳糖酶補充產品可幫助部分患者；避免乳製品時應留意鈣、維生素 D 與整體營養是否足夠；若為續發性且原發小腸疾病可逆，應治療原發病因，症狀可能隨之改善。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對（含原發性與續發性乳糖不耐之區分）。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Lactose intolerance is lactose malabsorption plus symptoms, and should be distinguished from milk protein allergy — allergy involves an immune mechanism and can cause systemic reactions, whereas lactose intolerance is a digestive-enzyme insufficiency.

Clinical presentation: Bloating, diarrhea, increased gas, nausea, abdominal pain, or borborygmi after consuming lactose; symptom severity varies with the amount of lactose consumed and individual tolerance, usually appearing within tens of minutes to a few hours after intake.

Key features: in the US, African American, American Indian, Asian American, and Hispanic/Latino populations have higher rates of lactose malabsorption; malabsorption is least common in people of European ancestry; primary lactase deficiency becomes more common with age; secondary lactase deficiency results from small-intestinal disease or injury and may improve once the underlying condition is treated.

Diagnostic approach: History confirming the temporal relationship between symptoms and lactose intake; a trial of reduced lactose intake can help with assessment; a hydrogen breath test can be used when confirmation is needed; persistent or atypical symptoms, or symptoms with weight loss or bloody stool, warrant evaluation for other GI conditions.

Differential diagnosis: milk protein allergy, celiac disease, irritable bowel syndrome, inflammatory bowel disease, small intestinal bacterial overgrowth.

Western treatment: Lactose intake is adjusted to individual tolerance; complete avoidance of dairy should not be assumed necessary for everyone; lactase enzyme products can help some patients; when dairy is avoided, adequate calcium, vitamin D, and overall nutrition should be monitored; if lactose intolerance is secondary to a reversible small-intestinal condition, treating the underlying cause may improve symptoms.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding (including the distinction between primary and secondary lactose intolerance).

records.summary_zh: 慢性B型肝炎是B型肝炎病毒（HBV）感染持續超過六個月，可造成進行性肝損傷，並增加肝硬化與肝癌風險；多數患者早期可能無症狀。
records.summary_en: Chronic hepatitis B is persistent hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection lasting more than six months; it can cause progressive liver damage and increases the risk of cirrhosis and liver cancer, and many patients are asymptomatic in earlier stages.
records.western_pathology_zh: HBV 感染肝細胞後，肝損傷主要來自宿主免疫系統對受感染肝細胞的攻擊，而非病毒直接的細胞毒性；持續的病毒複製與免疫反應可造成慢性壞死性發炎與進行性纖維化，長期可演變為肝硬化。嬰幼兒期感染較成人感染更容易演變為慢性感染。慢性 HBV 可經血液、體液（含性接觸）及母嬰垂直傳染散布；免疫抑制狀態下潛伏感染可能再活化。
records.western_pathology_en: After HBV infects hepatocytes, most of the liver injury comes from the host immune system attacking infected liver cells rather than direct viral cytotoxicity; ongoing viral replication and the immune response can cause chronic necroinflammation and progressive fibrosis, which over time can lead to cirrhosis. Infection acquired in infancy or early childhood is far more likely to become chronic than infection acquired as an adult. Chronic HBV spreads through blood, body fluids (including sexual contact), and perinatal (mother-to-child) transmission; latent infection can reactivate under immunosuppression.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：本卡聚焦慢性B型肝炎（感染持續逾六個月）；急性B肝感染多為自限性，但可能演變為慢性，尤其在嬰幼兒期感染者。

臨床表現：許多慢性感染者長期無症狀；可出現疲倦、食慾下降、噁心、腹部不適（尤其右上腹脅痛）、深色尿液或黃疸；慢性病常先因肝功能檢驗異常或肝硬化併發症（腹水、靜脈曲張出血、肝性腦病）而被發現；急性感染期可有較明顯的疲倦、發燒、關節或腹部疼痛、噁心嘔吐、食慾不振與黃疸。

重要特徵：嬰幼兒期感染者最容易演變為慢性；高風險族群包括母親帶原之新生兒、共用針具者、多重性伴侶或性傳染病史者、HIV 感染者、洗腎患者、醫療工作者職業暴露、監獄環境及來自高盛行地區者；慢性感染增加肝硬化、肝衰竭與肝細胞癌風險；免疫低下狀態下可能有B肝再活化。

診斷方法：以 HBV 血清學檢查（HBsAg、anti-HBs、anti-HBc 等）判定感染狀態與是否為慢性；慢性感染以 HBV DNA 病毒量與肝功能（ALT/AST、膽紅素）評估病毒活性與肝損傷程度；依情況安排影像或非侵入性纖維化評估（如彈性影像）；慢性感染需依風險定期評估肝硬化與肝細胞癌篩檢（如甲型胎兒蛋白、腹部超音波）。

鑑別診斷：其他病毒性肝炎（A、C、D、E 型）、酒精相關肝病、藥物引起的肝損傷、自體免疫性肝炎、代謝功能障礙相關脂肪肝病。

西醫治療：並非每位慢性 B 肝患者都需要抗病毒治療，需依病毒量、肝功能與肝纖維化程度決定；已造成或可能造成肝損傷之慢性 HBV，抗病毒治療（如核苷／核苷酸類似物）可降低疾病進展與併發症風險；需長期監測病毒量、肝功能、肝硬化與肝細胞癌風險；急性感染多以支持性治療為主，重症需專科處理；B型肝炎可經疫苗預防，母親帶原之新生兒需接受出生後預防措施。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對（急性與慢性B型肝炎編碼不同）。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: This card focuses on chronic hepatitis B (infection persisting beyond six months); acute HBV infection is usually self-limited but can become chronic, especially when acquired in infancy or early childhood.

Clinical presentation: Many people with chronic infection are asymptomatic for years; fatigue, decreased appetite, nausea, abdominal discomfort (especially right-upper-quadrant/hypochondriac pain), dark urine, or jaundice can occur; chronic disease is often first discovered through abnormal liver tests or complications of cirrhosis (ascites, variceal bleeding, hepatic encephalopathy); acute infection can present more prominently with fatigue, fever, joint or abdominal pain, nausea/vomiting, poor appetite, and jaundice.

Key features: infection acquired in infancy is most likely to become chronic; high-risk groups include infants born to HBV-positive mothers, people who inject drugs or share needles, those with multiple sexual partners or an STD history, people with HIV, dialysis patients, healthcare workers with occupational exposure, incarcerated individuals, and people from regions where hepatitis B is prevalent; chronic infection increases the risk of cirrhosis, liver failure, and hepatocellular carcinoma; reactivation can occur under immunosuppression.

Diagnostic approach: HBV serology (HBsAg, anti-HBs, anti-HBc, etc.) establishes infection status and chronicity; HBV DNA viral load and liver tests (ALT/AST, bilirubin) assess viral activity and liver injury in chronic infection; imaging or noninvasive fibrosis assessment (e.g., elastography) as indicated; chronic infection warrants periodic risk-based screening for cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (e.g., AFP, abdominal ultrasound).

Differential diagnosis: other viral hepatitis (A, C, D, E), alcohol-related liver disease, drug-induced liver injury, autoimmune hepatitis, metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease.

Western treatment: Not every patient with chronic HBV needs antiviral therapy; the decision depends on viral load, liver function, and degree of fibrosis; antiviral therapy (e.g., nucleos(t)ide analogues) reduces the risk of disease progression and complications when chronic HBV has caused or is likely to cause liver damage; long-term monitoring of viral load, liver function, and cirrhosis/hepatocellular carcinoma risk is required; acute infection is mostly managed with supportive care, with specialist management for severe cases; hepatitis B is vaccine-preventable, and infants born to HBV-positive mothers require postnatal prophylaxis.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding (acute and chronic hepatitis B have distinct codes).

records.summary_en: Persistent hepatitis C virus infection that may remain asymptomatic for years while progressing to fibrosis, cirrhosis, liver cancer, or liver failure.
records.western_context_zh: C 型肝炎病毒持續感染，可多年無症狀但逐步造成纖維化、肝硬化、肝癌與肝衰竭。
records.western_context_en: Persistent hepatitis C virus infection that may remain asymptomatic for years while progressing to fibrosis, cirrhosis, liver cancer, or liver failure.
records.western_pathology_zh: 病毒持續複製與宿主免疫反應造成慢性肝細胞損傷、發炎與纖維化。
records.western_pathology_en: Ongoing viral replication and host immune responses drive chronic hepatocyte injury, inflammation, and fibrosis.
records.etiology_zh: 病毒持續複製與宿主免疫反應造成慢性肝細胞損傷、發炎與纖維化。
records.etiology_en: Ongoing viral replication and host immune responses drive chronic hepatocyte injury, inflammation, and fibrosis.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 1992 年前輸血或未篩檢血液暴露
不安全醫療、刺青或針具暴露

risk_factors_en.factor: Transfusion before 1992 or exposure to unscreened blood
Unsafe medical, tattoo, or needle exposure

red_flags_zh.finding: 吐血、黑便、意識混亂或明顯腹脹
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為肝硬化失代償、出血或肝性腦病

red_flags_zh.finding: 黃疸快速加重、持續嘔吐或右上腹劇痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為急性肝損傷或其他肝膽急症

red_flags_en.finding: Hematemesis, black stool, confusion, or marked abdominal distension
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate decompensated cirrhosis, bleeding, or hepatic encephalopathy

red_flags_en.finding: Rapidly worsening jaundice, persistent vomiting, or severe right-upper-quadrant pain
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate acute liver injury or another hepatobiliary emergency

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 只能輔助處理疲勞、噁心或疼痛；不能清除 HCV，也不可延誤可治癒的直接抗病毒治療。不能清除 HCV、取代直接抗病毒藥或監測肝癌。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 有出血傾向、血小板低下、腹水或失代償肝病時避免深刺與強刺激。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與肝病／感染科共同管理抗病毒治療、纖維化與肝癌監測。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: CDC — Hepatitis C Basics
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May only support fatigue, nausea, or pain; it cannot clear HCV and must not delay curative direct-acting antiviral treatment. Cannot clear HCV, replace direct-acting antivirals, or provide liver-cancer surveillance.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Avoid deep or strong needling with bleeding tendency, thrombocytopenia, ascites, or decompensated liver disease.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage antiviral therapy, fibrosis, and liver-cancer surveillance with hepatology/infectious disease.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: CDC — Hepatitis C Basics
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

records.summary_zh: 以躁期／輕躁期與憂鬱發作造成情緒、能量、活動與功能明顯變化的精神疾病。
records.summary_en: A mental disorder marked by manic or hypomanic and depressive episodes that substantially change mood, energy, activity, and function.
records.western_context_zh: 以躁期／輕躁期與憂鬱發作造成情緒、能量、活動與功能明顯變化的精神疾病。
records.western_context_en: A mental disorder marked by manic or hypomanic and depressive episodes that substantially change mood, energy, activity, and function.
records.western_pathology_zh: 病因多因素，遺傳、腦功能與環境壓力共同參與；不是單純意志或性格問題。
records.western_pathology_en: Etiology is multifactorial, involving genetics, brain function, and environmental stress; it is not a matter of willpower or character.
records.etiology_zh: 病因多因素，遺傳、腦功能與環境壓力共同參與；不是單純意志或性格問題。
records.etiology_en: Etiology is multifactorial, involving genetics, brain function, and environmental stress; it is not a matter of willpower or character.

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 穩定期至多輔助睡眠、壓力或疼痛，不治療躁期或取代情緒穩定治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 每次評估情緒狀態與睡眠；躁期、混合期或急性自殺風險時停止常規照護。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與精神科／心理治療團隊共同管理，不自行停改藥物。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: During stability, acupuncture may at most support sleep, stress, or pain; it does not treat mania or replace mood-stabilizing care.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Assess mood state and sleep each visit; stop routine care during mania, mixed episodes, or acute suicide risk.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with psychiatry and psychotherapy; do not independently change medication.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: NIMH — Bipolar Disorder
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was identified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

records.summary_zh: 支氣管擴張症是支氣管長期異常擴張與氣道損傷的慢性肺部疾病，常形成黏液滯留、反覆感染與進一步氣道損傷的循環。
records.summary_en: Bronchiectasis is a chronic lung disorder with permanently damaged and widened airways, promoting mucus retention, recurrent infection, and further airway injury.
records.western_pathology_zh: 氣道結構損傷使清除分泌物能力下降；黏液滯留、感染與發炎彼此促進，逐步加重氣道破壞。
records.western_pathology_en: Structural airway injury impairs mucus clearance. Retained secretions, infection, and inflammation reinforce one another and can drive progressive airway damage.
records.western_context_zh:
臨床定位：支氣管擴張症為結構性氣道疾病，需與慢性阻塞性肺病、氣喘等其他慢性呼吸道疾病區分；診斷後應積極尋找可治療的原發原因。

臨床表現：持續或每日咳嗽、大量痰液、反覆呼吸道感染或急性惡化、呼吸困難、喘鳴或胸痛；咳血需評估嚴重度與來源。

重要特徵：黏液滯留—感染—發炎彼此促進形成惡性循環；需系統性尋找可矯正病因（如免疫缺損、纖毛功能障礙、感染後遺症）。

診斷方法：詳細病史與肺部檢查；胸部電腦斷層確認支氣管擴張；痰液培養或其他感染評估；肺功能檢查；依情況尋找免疫、感染、遺傳或其他原發原因。

鑑別診斷：慢性阻塞性肺病、氣喘、肺結核後遺症、原發性纖毛運動障礙、囊性纖維化。

西醫治療：治療原發原因與肺部感染；促進氣道清除與排痰；降低急性惡化與併發症；特定患者需氧療、介入或手術評估。

編碼備註：實際 ICD-10-CM 編碼須於個案登錄時依當年度 CDC/NCHS 版本核對。
records.western_context_en:
Clinical definition: Bronchiectasis is a structural airway disease that must be distinguished from other chronic respiratory diseases such as COPD and asthma; an underlying treatable cause should be actively sought after diagnosis.

Clinical presentation: Persistent or daily cough, large-volume sputum production, recurrent respiratory infections or exacerbations, dyspnea, wheeze or chest pain; hemoptysis requires assessment of severity and source.

Key features: Mucus retention, infection and inflammation reinforce one another in a vicious cycle; a systematic search for correctable causes (immune deficiency, ciliary dysfunction, post-infectious sequelae) is warranted.

Diagnostic approach: Detailed history and lung examination; chest CT to confirm bronchiectatic change; sputum culture or other infection evaluation; pulmonary function testing; etiologic workup for immune, infectious, genetic, or other causes when indicated.

Differential diagnosis: COPD, asthma, post-tuberculous sequelae, primary ciliary dyskinesia, cystic fibrosis.

Western treatment: Treat underlying causes and pulmonary infections; improve airway clearance and mucus removal; reduce exacerbations and complications; selected patients may require oxygen, procedures, or surgical evaluation.

Coding note: exact ICD-10-CM code selection requires the current fiscal-year CDC/NCHS review at the time of coding.
